context: Continuous positive momentum across all three indices may have seated buyers. They chose quantity carefully because of the intervening holiday; their presence alone does not make them immediately huntable.
plan: FLAT TO GAP UP -> BUY WITH THE MARKET: buyers remain unpressured, so seek confirmed buying-side setups. BANKNIFTY must not turn sharply negative immediately after opening.

MEANINGFUL GAP DOWN -> SELL: seek confirmed selling-side setups against the buyers. On SENSEX the gap should at least break support to expose their risk; do not treat every tiny gap down as sufficient.
